title: [Audit] All mutations — every create, update and delete
description: Every create, update and delete in Kibana, plus every Elasticsearch security configuration change (API keys, roles, user profiles): the shortest, highest-value list in the audit stream. Kibana’s own routine API-key clean-up is left out.
esql: SET unmapped_fields="nullify"; FROM logs-elastic_cloud.serverless_audit.otel-default | WHERE (service.name == "serverless-kibana" AND ((event.type IN ("change","creation","deletion") AND (event.action IS NULL OR NOT (event.action IN ("saved_object_open_point_in_time","saved_object_close_point_in_time")))) OR event.action IN ("rule_run_soon","secret_create"))) OR elasticsearch.audit.security_config_change IS NOT NULL | WHERE NOT (event.action IS NOT NULL AND event.action == "invalidate_apikeys" AND user.name IS NOT NULL AND user.name IN ("elastic.maintenance","autoscaling","elasticsearch-controller","elastic/fleet-server","elastic/kibana") AND api_key.name IS NULL) | SORT @timestamp DESC | LIMIT 1000 | EVAL actor = CASE(user.email IS NOT NULL, user.email, api_key.name IS NOT NULL, api_key.name, user.domain == "_cloud_api_key", CONCAT(user.name, " · Cloud API key"), user.domain == "_es_api_key", CONCAT("Unnamed key of ", user.name), user.name IS NOT NULL, user.name, "(unattributed)"), actor_kind = CASE(user.email IS NOT NULL, "human", "service") | EVAL verb = CASE(event.action LIKE "*_execution_cancel", "cancel", event.action LIKE "*_run_soon", "run", event.action LIKE "*_run", "run", event.action LIKE "*_test", "test", event.action LIKE "*_enable", "enable", event.action LIKE "*_disable", "disable", event.action LIKE "ml_put_*", "create", event.action LIKE "ml_open_*", "open", event.action LIKE "ml_start_*", "start", event.action LIKE "*point_in_time", "pit", event.action LIKE "*_create*", "create", event.action LIKE "*_update*", "update", event.action LIKE "*_delete", "delete", event.action LIKE "*_find", "find", event.action LIKE "*_get", "get", event.action LIKE "*_resolve", "resolve", "other") | GROK body.text """\[(?:id|workflowId)=%{DATA:g_id}(?:,|\])""" | GROK body.text """\[name=%{GREEDYDATA:g_name}\]""" | GROK body.text """\[executionId=%{DATA:g_exec}\]""" | GROK body.text """case id: %{NOTSPACE:g_case}""" | GROK body.text """(?:job|datafeed) %{NOTSPACE:g_ml}""" | EVAL obj_type = CASE(kibana.saved_object.type IS NOT NULL, kibana.saved_object.type, event.action LIKE "ml_*ad_job", "ml-job", event.action LIKE "ml_*ad_datafeed", "ml-datafeed", event.action LIKE "workflow_execution_*", "workflow-execution", event.action LIKE "workflow_*", "workflow", event.action LIKE "agent_builder_agent_*", "agent-builder-agent", event.action LIKE "agent_builder_tool_*", "agent-builder-tool", event.action LIKE "product_documentation_*", "product-documentation", event.action == "secret_create", "secret", event.action IS NULL, "unclassified", REPLACE(event.action, "_(create|update|delete|enable|disable|run|run_soon|test|cancel)$", "")) | EVAL obj_name = COALESCE(kibana.saved_object.name, g_name, g_id, kibana.saved_object.id, g_case, g_ml, g_exec, body.text) | GROK elasticsearch.audit.security_config_change """"name":"%{DATA:t_name}"""" | GROK elasticsearch.audit.security_config_change """"ids":\[%{DATA:t_ids}\]""" | GROK elasticsearch.audit.security_config_change """"id":"%{DATA:t_id}"""" | GROK elasticsearch.audit.security_config_change """"uid":"%{DATA:t_uid}"""" | EVAL target = COALESCE(t_name, REPLACE(REPLACE(t_ids, "\"", ""), ",", ", "), t_id, t_uid) | EVAL obj_name = COALESCE(obj_name, target, CASE(elasticsearch.audit.security_config_change IS NOT NULL, "(none named in the payload)")), message = COALESCE(body.text, elasticsearch.audit.security_config_change) | EVAL obj_type = CASE(service.name == "serverless-kibana", obj_type, event.action LIKE "*apikey*", "api-key", event.action LIKE "*_role", "role", event.action LIKE "*user_profile*", "user-profile", obj_type) | KEEP @timestamp, actor, verb, event.action, obj_type, obj_name, kibana.space.id, message | EVAL actor = REPLACE(REPLACE(actor, "^([-_A-Za-z0-9]{5})[-_A-Za-z0-9]{15} · Cloud API key$", "$1… · Cloud API key"), "^Unnamed key of ([-_A-Za-z0-9]{5})[-_A-Za-z0-9]{15}$", "Unnamed key of $1…") | RENAME @timestamp AS Time, actor AS Identity, verb AS Operation, event.action AS Action, obj_type AS `Object type`, obj_name AS Object, kibana.space.id AS `Space id`, message AS Message
